descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations. The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments. Your Impact Financial Management & Reporting - Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI - Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI - Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions - Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies New Investments & Business Evaluation - Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities Budgeting & Forecasting - Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes - Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets - Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights Cross-Functional Support - Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments. - Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications - Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments Process Improvement & Systems - Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities - Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed - Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred) with a Big 4 background - 6–10 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including exposure to investments, or multi-entity environments - Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, retail, consumer services, or asset-heavy industries is a strong plus - Solid understanding of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting - Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting principles and financial controls - Fluent in English, French and/or Italian are a plus Your Essentials - Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset - Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders - Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple stakeholders - High attention to detail with the ability to see the big picture - Excellent communication and relationship-building skills Our commitment We are committed to building a future that values diverse perspectives, embraces the world beyond borders, and fosters an inclusive environment where every individual feels valued, respected and empowered to be their authentic selves. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Working at the heart of the business and in close partnership with the Corporate HR team, the Senior HR Business Partner provides strategic and hands-on HR support to assigned corporate functions and offices worldwide, within a fast-paced, service-driven hospitality environment. Reporting to the Head of HR, this role partners with senior leaders to translate business priorities into effective people solutions, while ensuring consistent application of Group HR policies, processes, and standards. The Senior HRBP plays a key role in driving performance, engagement, and organisational effectiveness in a complex, international organisation where operational excellence, agility, and customer focus are critical. Your Impact - Act as the primary HR partner for assigned corporate functions, providing strategic advice and operational HR support aligned with business objectives; - Equip leaders with the tools, frameworks, and guidance required to effectively manage their teams in line with Group values and people policies; - Partner with senior leaders to support workforce planning and organisational needs, ensuring capabilities and capacity are aligned with current and future business requirements; - Collaborate closely with Talent Acquisition and hiring managers to define recruitment needs and support delivery of hiring plans in line with agreed KPIs; - Drive performance and accountability by supporting the implementation of the Group performance management framework, including goal setting, evaluation cycles, and manager capability building; - Support talent management processes within the business perimeter, including talent reviews, identification of high-potential employees, succession discussions, and development actions, in coordination with the Head of HR and relevant Centers of Expertise; - Advise managers on employee relations matters, ensuring fair, consistent, and compliant people decisions; - Support change management and organisational initiatives by assessing people impact, supporting leaders through transitions, and ensuring clear and effective communication; - Contribute to key HR cycles such as annual compensation reviews, talent reviews, and employee engagement initiatives; - Work closely with HR Operations, Payroll, and HRIS teams to ensure smooth execution of HR processes and digital tools; - Participate in global HR projects and initiatives, contributing business insight and supporting effective local implementation; - Conduct exit interviews, analyse turnover trends, and contribute to retention and engagement actions within the business perimeter. Your Journey so far - Master’s degree in Human Resources, Business Administration, or a related field; - Minimum 10 years of progressive HR experience in a matrixed, multinational environment, including at least 5 -7 years in a Senior HR Business Partner or equivalent role; - Proven HR experience within the hospitality, cruise, travel or customer-centric industry, with a strong understanding of service culture; - Demonstrated experience partnering with senior leaders in a corporate or headquarters environment; - Strong project management skills, with the ability to plan, coordinate, and deliver HR initiatives involving multiple stakeholders and tight timelines; - Solid exposure to performance management, talent processes, employee relations, and organisational support; - Experience working with global HR policies, frameworks, and HR systems (HRIS); - Knowledge of Swiss Labour Law is an advantage; - Fluent in English; French is an advantage. Your Essentials - Strong business acumen with the ability to translate strategy into pragmatic HR solutions; - Credible and confident advisor, able to influence, challenge, and build trust with senior stakeholders; - Strong understanding of hospitality and service excellence cultures, with the ability to balance people care, performance, and operational demands; - Ability to balance strategic thinking with hands-on delivery in a fast-paced, high-expectation environment. - Structured, reliable, and comfortable operating across multiple priorities; - Collaborative mindset, with the ability to work effectively across HR functions and with diverse stakeholders; - High standards of integrity, discretion, and professional judgment; - Flexible, resilient, and solution-oriented, with a continuous improvement mindset. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions.

Your Impact

- Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions.

- Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards.

- Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans.

- Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements.

- Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours.

- Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency.

- Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation.

- Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings.

- Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations.

- Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence.

Your Journey so far

- 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered.

- 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders.

- A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred.

Your Essentials

- Flexibility and strong analytical skills.

- Excellent communication and collaboration abilities.

- IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous.

- Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher).

- Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery.

- Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset.

- Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time.

- Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland.

descriptionByLocale.it: Il tuo scopo Il Direttore delle Operazioni è responsabile per la progettazione, la mobilitazione, l'apertura e il funzionamento in corso di grandi dimensioni navi da crociera e infrastrutture di ospitalità. Il ruolo assicura la continuità dello sviluppo attraverso operazioni a stato costante, agendo come proprietario operativo dalle prime fasi di costruzione attraverso prestazioni a lungo termine. Lavorando in parallelo con lo sviluppo, la costruzione e l'esperienza degli ospiti, il direttore delle operazioni garantisce che i beni sono operabili dal design, completamente pronti all'apertura e in modo sostenibile, sicuro e redditizio in seguito. Il vostro impatto 1. Leadership operativa Attraverso il ciclo di vita delle risorse proprie responsabilità operativa end-to-end dalla pre-apertura attraverso operazioni dal vivo. Definire la visione operativa a lungo termine, KPI e standard di servizio. Garantire continuità di progettazione, cultura e sistemi dalla fase di progetto alle operazioni a stato costante. 2. Pre-apertura e mobilitazione (Parallel to Construction) Guidare il programma di disponibilità operativa allineato con pietre miliari di costruzione. In coordinamento con Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment ecc.), definisce le esigenze di Procurements e implementarlo. FFE/OWS. Decisioni di progettazione di influenza per garantire efficienza operativa, sicurezza e manutenbilità. Stabilire strutture operative, SOP e governance ben prima dell'apertura. Gestire gli abbonamenti dalla costruzione alle operazioni, compresi i fatturato phased. Per ogni progetto, identificare le necessità del personale e - in combinazione con le risorse umane- garantire la capacità operativa di nuovi asset. Stabilire programmi di formazione per la disponibilità operativa. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Operazioni giornaliere dirette in tutti i dipartimenti (ospitalità, F&B, vendita al dettaglio, attrazioni, marine, sicurezza, manutenzione, servizi ospiti). Assicurare la consegna di esperienze, sicurezza, qualità dei servizi e standard di marca. Guidare la stabilità operativa durante le fasi di rampa e maturità. Condurre iniziative di miglioramento continuo attraverso il bene. 4. Forza di lavoro, formazione e cultura costruire, condurre e mantenere una forza lavoro multinazionale ad alto rendimento. Mantenere ed evolvere i programmi di formazione post-apertura. Integra una cultura orientata alla sicurezza e alle prestazioni. 5. Financial & Commercial Performance Own operativo P&L, controlli dei costi e metriche di produttività. Gestisci bilanci operativi, capex pianificazione e riserve del ciclo di vita. Collaborare con i team commerciali per ottimizzare i ricavi (F&B, retail, esperienze, escursioni a riva dove applicabile). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Assicurare il rispetto costante di tutti gli standard normativi, marittimi, sanitari, di sicurezza e ambientali. Guidare la preparazione di emergenza, la gestione delle crisi e la pianificazione della continuità aziendale. Servire come responsabile per gli audit e le ispezioni. Il vostro viaggio finora - 15+ anni senior operazioni leadership in ospitalità, destinazioni da crociera, resort, porti, parchi a tema o grandi attività di ospitalità. - Proprietà dimostrata delle operazioni pre-apertura e a lungo termine. - Forte background che lavora insieme a team di sviluppo, costruzione e servizi tecnici. - Esperienza in ambienti caraibici o isolati fortemente preferito. Il vostro Essentials - Operazioni di prontezza e di ciclo di vita - Leader della forza lavoro su larga scala - Contabilità finanziaria e P&L - Gestione del ciclo di vita e della manutenzione - Gestione multioperatoria e delle concessioni Il nostro impegno Siamo impegnati a costruire un futuro che valorizza prospettive diverse, abbraccia il mondo oltre i confini, e promuove un ambiente inclusivo in cui ogni individuo si sente valutato, rispettato e potenziato per essere il loro sé autentico. Il nostro impegno si estende a intraprendere azioni significative e misurabili che hanno un impatto positivo a lungo termine sui nostri ospiti, sui nostri dipendenti e sul nostro pianeta. Pronto a trasformare la tua passione in qualcosa di straordinario? Unisciti a noi a MSC Crociere, dove attendono nuove opportunità. Applicare oggi per essere parte di un team globale che sta spingendo i confini e raggiungere qualcosa di notevole. Il tuo viaggio inizia qui!
descriptionByLocale.en: Your Purpose The Director of Operations is accountable for the design, mobilization, opening and ongoing operation of large-scale cruise and hospitality infrastructure assets. The role ensures continuity from development through steady-state operations, acting as the operational owner from early construction phases through long-term performance. Working in parallel with Development, Construction and Guest Experience, the Director of Operations guarantees that assets are operable by design, fully ready at opening, and sustainably efficient, safe and profitable thereafter. Ensure delivery of guest experience, safety, service quality and brand standards. Drive operational stability during ramp-up and maturity phases. Maintain and evolve training programs post-opening. Embed a safety-first, service-oriented and performance-driven culture. 5. Collaborate with commercial teams to optimize revenue (F&B, retail, experiences, shore excursions where applicable). 6. Compliance, Safety & Risk Management Ensure ongoing compliance with all regulatory, maritime, health, safety and environmental standards. Lead emergency preparedness, crisis management and business continuity planning. Serve as the accountable executive for audits and inspections. descriptionByLocale.de: Ihr Ziel Der Operationsdirektor ist verantwortlich für das Design, die Mobilisierung, die Eröffnung und den laufenden Betrieb von großen Kreuzfahrt- und Gastfreundschaft-Infrastrukturanlagen. Die Rolle sorgt für Kontinuität von der Entwicklung durch stationäre Operationen, die als Betriebsinhaber von frühen Bauphasen durch langfristige Leistung fungieren. Parallel zur Entwicklungs-, Bau- und Gasterfahrung garantiert der Leiter der Geschäftstätigkeit, dass die Vermögenswerte durch Design, vollständig bereit zur Eröffnung und nachhaltig effizient, sicher und profitabel sind. Ihre Auswirkungen 1. Operationelle Führung über den Asset Lifecycle Eigene operative End-to-End-Verantwortung von der Voröffnung durch Live-Operationen. Definieren Sie die Langzeit-Betriebsvision, Kennzahlen und Servicestandards. Gewährleistung der Kontinuität von Design, Kultur und Systemen von der Projektphase bis hin zu stationären Betrieben. 2. Pre-Opening & Mobilization (Parallel to Construction) Führen Sie das betriebsbereite Programm im Einklang mit Bau Meilensteinen. In Abstimmung mit Corporate Guest Services (F&B, HK, Entertainment etc.) definieren Sie die Beschaffungsbedürfnisse und implementieren sie. FFE/OWS. Einflussentscheidungen zur Sicherstellung der betrieblichen Effizienz, Sicherheit und Aufrechterhaltungsfähigkeit. Stellen Sie operative Strukturen, SOPs und Governance vor der Eröffnung fest. Manage Handover von Bau zu Betrieb, einschließlich phased Umsatz. Für jedes Projekt sorgen Personalbedarf und - in Verbindung mit Personal - die operativen Fähigkeiten neuer Vermögenswerte. Ausbildungsprogramme für Betriebsbereitschaft einrichten. 3. Post-Opening Operations Management Direkte tägliche Operationen in allen Abteilungen (Krankheit, F&B, Einzelhandel, Attraktionen, Marine, Sicherheit, Wartung, Gastdienste). descriptionByLocale.fr: Votre but Le Directeur des opérations est responsable de la conception, de la mobilisation, de l'ouverture et de l'exploitation continue de grands équipements de croisière et d'accueil. Ce rôle assure la continuité du développement par des opérations en état d'équilibre, agissant en tant que propriétaire opérationnel depuis les premières phases de construction jusqu'à la performance à long terme. Parallèlement au développement, à la construction et à l'expérience des invités, le Directeur des opérations garantit que les actifs sont exploitables par la conception, prêts à l'ouverture et durables, sûrs et rentables par la suite. 1. Leadership opérationnel Tout au long du cycle de vie de l'actif Responsabilité opérationnelle de bout en bout de la préouverture à des opérations réelles. Définir la vision opérationnelle à long terme, les ICR et les normes de service. Assurer la continuité de la conception, de la culture et des systèmes depuis la phase du projet jusqu'aux opérations en état d'équilibre. 2. Préouverture et mobilisation (parallèle à la construction) Diriger le programme de préparation opérationnelle aligné sur les étapes de construction. En coordination avec les Services invités (F&B, HK, Entertainment, etc.), définir les besoins en matière d'approvisionnement et les mettre en oeuvre. - Oui. Influencer les décisions de conception pour assurer l'efficacité opérationnelle, la sécurité et la maintenance. Établir les structures opérationnelles, les PON et la gouvernance bien avant l'ouverture. Gérer les transferts de la construction à l'exploitation, y compris les roulements échelonnés. Pour chaque projet, déterminer les besoins en personnel et, de concert avec les RH, assurer la capacité opérationnelle des nouveaux biens. Établir des programmes de formation pour la préparation opérationnelle. 3. Intégrer une culture axée sur la sécurité, le service et la performance. 5. Rendement financier et commercial Propre P&L opérationnelle, contrôle des coûts et indicateurs de productivité. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose In line with current and future tourism trends, the Shore Excursions Product Development Manager oversees product content and delivery, negotiates costs, and develops new tours to grow revenue and enhance guest satisfaction in specific geographical regions. Your Impact - Lead the development of innovative shore excursion products and manage the tour program for assigned regions. - Source and procure high-quality excursions in line with seasonal demand and company standards. - Monitor market trends, guest preferences, and potential risks to develop effective action and improvement plans. - Analyze guest feedback and satisfaction scores to drive continuous product and service enhancements. - Build and maintain relationships with up to 100 tour operators, overseeing a portfolio of 1,000+ tours. - Negotiate contracts with suppliers, manage large-scale bids, and optimize costs to ensure profitability and efficiency. - Collaborate cross-functionally with Legal, Insurance, and Operations teams to ensure compliance and risk mitigation. - Oversee product creation, feedback analysis, and product revamping to maintain competitive and engaging offerings. - Ensure inventory accuracy and perform regular site inspections within assigned destinations. - Represent the company at government meetings, industry events, and travel conventions to strengthen partnerships and brand presence. Your Journey so far - 10 years of experience in the Shore Excursions Department within the cruise industry (either onboard or ashore) is preferred. Experience in shore excursion operations within the hospitality industry or with a global tour operator may also be considered. - 5–10+ years of proven experience in global shore excursion operations is required, including product development, bid management, and cross-functional collaboration with legal, insurance, and operations stakeholders. - A bachelor’s degree in tourism and proficiency in multiple languages are highly preferred. Your Essentials - Flexibility and strong analytical skills. - Excellent communication and collaboration abilities. - IT-savvy; experience with Fidelio is highly advantageous. - Advanced proficiency in Microsoft Office applications (Excel, Word, PowerPoint, Publisher). - Extensive knowledge of shore excursion products and operational delivery. - Fluent in English with a good command of Italian; additional languages are an asset. - Willingness to travel up to 25% of the time. - Must hold an EU passport or have the legal right to work in Switzerland. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Head of Learning & Development (Onboard & Ashore) and Talent Management (Ashore) is responsible for defining and leading the global strategy for Learning and Development across both shipboard and shore-based employees, while overseeing Talent Management and Succession Planning for shore-based populations only. The role ensures the company develops the capabilities required to deliver exceptional guest experiences, operational excellence, and strong leadership across a global workforce, including thousands of shipboard crew and a diverse shore-based organization. For shipboard employees, the role focuses on building world-class operational and service capabilities through structured training, leadership development, and career progression frameworks that support fleet performance and guest satisfaction. For shore-based employees, the role leads both Learning & Development and Talent Management, including leadership development, succession planning, and talent pipeline development for corporate and operational leadership roles. Working closely with senior operational leaders across Operations, Guest Experience, and Corporate Functions, this role drives a culture of continuous learning, leadership excellence, and organizational capability building across the company’s global operations. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose Lead and define the strategic planning, deployment, and operational management of the Multimedia Department while supporting audiovisual (AV) systems across fleet and corporate infrastructure. Oversee fleet multimedia content, technology innovation, and AV operations to maximise guest experience and maintain consistent brand standards. Working closely with global teams, new build projects, and external stakeholders, drive collaboration across Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical functions to deliver seamless digital experiences. The AV scope expands beyond traditional multimedia, supporting wider technical initiatives across the Entertainment division — including theatrical and guest activities — and acting as a key bridge between operational entertainment needs and technical delivery teams. Your Impact - Manage multimedia and AV operations, including the design, implementation, optimisation, and lifecycle management of audio, video, broadcast, digital signage, and content delivery systems. - Partner with shoreside and onboard technical teams to ensure equipment reliability, structured maintenance planning, operational scheduling, and agreed repair strategies across the fleet. - Lead cross-functional initiatives with Entertainment, Marketing, IT, Digital, Production, and technical stakeholders to deliver innovative onboard and shoreside guest experiences. - Act as the primary liaison between Entertainment, Production vendors, external contractors, and the Show and Multimedia department, translating creative and operational requirements into scalable technical solutions. - Advise and support New Build projects on multimedia and AV technical requirements, ensuring future-proof, sustainable technology integration. - Collaborate with Brand, Marketing, and content providers to develop, brief, and implement new ship-based media content strategies and onboard marketing initiatives. - Define and project manage operational workflows and delivery plans for Entertainment and onboard marketing content across shipboard screens and digital platforms. - Oversee vendor relationships, procurement activities, and associated budgets to maintain cost efficiency while ensuring technical excellence. - Monitor and evaluate global technology trends to keep fleet systems innovative, competitive, and aligned with evolving guest expectations. - Develop, maintain, and continuously improve standard operating procedures and technical standards, ensuring fleetwide consistency, safety, and operational efficiency in line with corporate Entertainment guidelines. - Supervise, appraise, and mentor ship-based and touring technicians globally, ensuring compliance with safety, maritime, and corporate policies. - Support live events, broadcasting, corporate communications, and multimedia initiatives through strategic planning combined with hands-on technical leadership. - Manage and govern visual content provided by internal and external partners for broadcast across onboard platforms. Your Journey so far - Extensive experience within cruise environments is a must. - Senior operational and managerial experience within the Entertainment industry. - Mother tongue English; Italian, German, or Spanish advantageous. - Strong background in broadcasting, web, TV, theatrical production, or digital media operations with managerial responsibility. - Knowledge of enterprise Content Management Systems and digital platforms. - Solid IT literacy with understanding of systems architecture and AV integration. - Full understanding of LES systems within the maritime industry. - Advanced computer literacy (Microsoft Office, Adobe Creative Suite, and CAD software). - Strong project management and stakeholder coordination skills. - Proven ability to work autonomously, solve complex operational challenges, and manage global teams. - International mindset with experience supporting mixed-nationality audiences and global operations. - Willingness to travel extensively. descriptionByLocale.it: Your Purpose The Culinary Operations Manager provides strategic leadership and oversight for all culinary operations across the fleet. The Manager of Culinary Operations is a strategic role on the overall financial cost of the culinary department, monitoring and guiding the team, and actively participating in recruitment for leadership positions within the culinary function. Acting as the strategic link between the corporate office in Geneva and the traveling and shipboard teams, this role ensures consistent quality, compliance with corporate standards, and continuous culinary innovation. This role directly reports to the Vice President of F&B. Your Impact Strategic Culinary Leadership - Provide visionary leadership and guidance for the culinary team across the fleet, ensuring alignment with brand philosophy. - Define, implement, and uphold fleet-wide culinary operational standards and best practices. - Play an active role in strategic planning for all F&B service and beverage needs. - Lead menu development, recipe creation, and implementation of culinary projects. Operational Oversight & Quality Assurance - Conduct structured operational reviews, remote audits, and ship visits as required. - Ensure food quality, presentation, and consistency across all vessels. - Monitor guest satisfaction metrics and implement strategic improvements. - Ensure compliance with global health, safety, and hygiene protocols. - Oversee beverage order and loading coordination. Training & Leadership Development - Mentor and develop future culinary leaders and onboard chefs. - Design and implement fleet-wide training programs in line with brand standards. - Foster long-term succession planning for culinary leadership positions. Human Resources & Team Management - Drive a high-performance culture emphasizing recognition, development, and fairness. - Oversee leadership performance reviews, promotions, and career pathing. - Support HR in recruitment for senior culinary positions and host rotations. Fleet Support & Headquarters Coordination - Act as the principal liaison for all culinary matters between corporate headquarters and the fleet. - Coordinate galley equipment planning, material sourcing, and integration of brand standards. - Compile operational and financial reports for corporate leadership. Financial Oversight - Overseeing food orders and maintaining the food master list to ensure accuracy, proper order planning, and sequence management. - Responsible for overall financial cost of the culinary department. - Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning. - Play a key role for the overall financial cost of the culinary department. - Implement continuous improvement plans to meet or exceed economic targets. - Oversee cost control, inventory optimization, and resource planning. Your Journey so far - Minimum 15 years in high-end culinary operations with advanced skills. - At least 5 years in senior leadership roles within luxury hospitality or cruise operations. - Proven experience in fleet-wide or multi-site culinary management. Your Essentials Leadership & Communication - Dynamic, strategic leader with experience managing multicultural teams. - Excellent communication skills, fluent in English; additional languages an asset. Technical & Operational Knowledge - Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and industry-specific systems. - Knowledge of HR protocols, time and attendance compliance, and labor regulations. - Expertise in culinary operations, menu development, and luxury hospitality standards. descriptionByLocale.en:
Your Purpose

The Finance and Accounting Manager – New Investments will lead financial oversight, accounting, and performance management for the company’s new Strategic Value Chain Investments (“SVCI”). This role plays a critical part in ensuring strong financial controls, and partnering with cross-functional teams to optimize profitability across non-core cruise operations.
The ideal candidate brings a blend of technical accounting expertise, commercial finance acumen, and experience supporting investment-driven or multi-business environments.

Your Impact

Financial Management & Reporting

- Oversee accounting, month-end close, and financial reporting for SVCI

- Ensure accurate revenue recognition, cost allocation, and margin analysis for SVCI

- Prepare and review management reports, KPIs, and variance analyses to support business decisions

- Maintain compliance with internal controls, accounting standards, and company policies

New Investments & Business Evaluation

- Track post-investment performance versus plan and identify risks and improvement opportunities

Budgeting & Forecasting

- Assist the investments and the group during budgeting and rolling forecast processes

- Partner with operational leaders to develop realistic assumptions and financial targets

- Monitor performance against budgets and provide actionable insights

Cross-Functional Support

- Act as a finance business partner to support potential synergies within the investments.

- Collaborate with Legal, Treasury, Operations, and Commercial teams on contract structures, pricing models, and financial implications

- Support strategic initiatives related to expansion, innovation, and optimization of new investments

Process Improvement & Systems

- Improve financial processes, reporting automation, and data quality across investment activities

- Support implementation or enhancement of ERP, reporting tools, or financial systems as needed

- Identify opportunities to scale finance processes as new businesses grow

Your Journey so far

- Master’s degree in Finance, Accounting, or related field (CPA, ACA, ACCA, or equivalent strongly preferred) with a Big 4 background

- 6–10 years of progressive experience in finance and accounting, including exposure to investments, or multi-entity environments

- Experience in hospitality, travel, cruise, retail, consumer services, or asset-heavy industries is a strong plus

- Solid understanding of financial modeling, budgeting, forecasting, and management reporting

- Strong knowledge of IFRS accounting principles and financial controls

- Fluent in English, French and/or Italian are a plus

Your Essentials

- Strong analytical and problem-solving skills with a commercial mindset

- Ability to translate financial data into clear insights for non-finance stakeholders

- Comfortable working in a fast-paced, evolving environment with multiple stakeholders

- High attention to detail with the ability to see the big picture

Where passion meets opportunity Discover your journey into the extraordinary. Your Purpose Explora Journeys is a vibrant, cosmopolitan, European luxury brand, imagined in the heart of Swiss hospitality in Geneva. The CRM Director – Insights, Customer Lifecycle & Marketing Automation leads the strategy and activation of data-driven customer engagement programs to inform the business and support commercial growth, loyalty and lifetime value. The role acts as business lead for lifecycle marketing and marketing automation, working in close partnership with Commercial, Digital, IT, Data and Legal teams to ensure scalable, compliant and high-performing customer communications. He/ She leads the customer’s insights area recommending how to approach the brand evolution assessment. The role is based in Geneva, Switzerland. Your Impact 1. Lifecycle Strategy & Co-Ownership
• Lead the definition of the global customer lifecycle strategy organizing the customer journey vision with Commercial, Digital and Guest Experience teams.
• Translate lifecycle ambition into structured activation roadmaps across owned marketing automation channels.
• Define lifecycle design principles, segmentation logic and engagement frameworks aligned with brand and commercial objectives.
• Ensure cross-functional alignment between customer experience, commercial priorities and lifecycle communications. 2. Journey Activation & Channel Governance
• Lead automated journey orchestration primarily across owned CRM channels
• Establish governance for segmentation, personalization and campaign standards.
• Coordinate with other channel owners (e.g., Media, Social, Digital) to ensure journey consistency.
• Drive structured adoption of personalization and audience activation tools. 3. Platform Business Ownership
• Act as business product owner of marketing automation platforms (e.g., Salesforce Marketing Cloud).
• Define functional requirements, prioritization and business roadmap.
• Partner with IT, as technical owner, for architecture, integrations, security and scalability.
• Ensure operational excellence of automations, data flows and activation processes. 4. Data Governance & Compliance
• Define lifecycle communication standards in alignment with Legal and IT.
• Ensure consent management and subscription governance frameworks are operationalized within marketing automation tools.
• Support privacy-by-design principles across activation use cases. 5. Commercial Impact & Performance
• Define CRM contribution metrics and dashboards.
• Monitor engagement, retention and revenue influence.
• Provide optimization roadmaps to senior leadership. 6. Lead the development of a customer insights framework, leveraging CRM data, external ad hoc research to inform brand health evolution. Translate customer understanding into actionable growth opportunities. Partner with Guest Experience teams, Marketing and Commercial teams to design and prioritize customer research initiatives, including satisfaction tracking, journey analysis, loyalty drivers, brand tracking,etc. 7. Team & Capability Building
• Build a high-performing marketing CRM team.
• Elevate internal understanding of marketing automation capabilities and limitations.
• Drive adoption and maturity of audience strategy and segmentation practices. Your Journey so far
• 15+ years of experience in CRM, customer lifecycle management, marketing automation or customer data roles, ideally in global and local environments.
• Proven experience driving customer acquisition, engagement, loyalty and retention through CRM at scale.
• Proven experience designing and managing complex customer journeys across multiple channels, markets and touchpoints, including long consideration and purchase cycles
• Deep understanding of CRM platforms, marketing automation tools and data-driven marketing,
• Solid knowledge on global standards for data capture, consent management, governance, and enrichment
• Strong analytical mindset with experience translating CRM data into actionable insights. Experience leading customer insights initiatives such as segmentation studies, loyalty drivers, NPS/satisfaction research or journey diagnostics.
• Proven people manager, able to build, structure and develop teams to deliver measurable business outcomes.
• Strong track record of working hands-on while leading strategically, especially in complex or fast-growth environments.
• Experience managing agencies and external partners.
• Prior experience in luxury, premium or high-end consumer brands strongly preferred as well as Travel & hospitality Your Essentials
• Strategic, customer-centric and commercially minded leader.
• Highly analytical, data-driven and comfortable translating insights into action.
• Technically savvy, with the ability to bridge business, data and technology teams.
• Structured, detail-oriented and able to manage multiple priorities in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
• Outstanding collaboration and influencing skills, with proven ability to operate in a matrix organization.
